channel.title: Batteries: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the batteries sector.

item.title: Eco&Dream: Eco&Dream signs KRW 24.36bn high-nickel NCM precursor supply contract with Umicore SA, equal to 17.16% of recent revenue.
Ecopro BM: Ecopro BM subsidiary Ecopro Global Investment decides rights offering of 596,750,130 new shares to fund PT BNSI smelter stake acquisition
Fino: KOSDAQ halted trading in Pino common shares on 2026-11-05 to determine whether a backdoor listing applies and requirements are met.
item.description: Trading halt pending backdoor listing review
